text:
alex: heads up — opened a small hotfix PR for prod cache timeout that's been causing a few 503s during the last hour. needs a quick review + approval to canary deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4278 — fixes nil check + tightens timeout (500ms -> 200ms).

maya: on it, pulling the branch now.

sam: oncall here — is this safe to canary or should we rollback the previous change first? current error rate ~1.8% on cache-service, latency spikes seen on /v1/generate.

alex: rollback would be heavier and slower. patch is tiny and addresses the NPE causing evict to hang. plan: canary to prod-canary, monitor 5m, then promote.

linh: quick scan, logic looks fine. one nit: add a bit more context in the exception log so we can correlate user_id. otherwise LGTM.

maya: left two inline comments about an edge-case in test. running tests locally reproduces a flake on test_evict_race_condition.

ci-bot: CI status: python-unit-tests failed (test_cache_timeout::test_evict_race_condition). Re-run with `/retest`.

maya: /retest

ci-bot: CI status: All checks passed ✅ (python-unit-tests, integration, lint).

sam: approved. @alex please add canary flag and kick the canary deploy. set alert for error_rate > 1.5% for 2m so we can auto-rollback if it regresses. :eyes:

alex: added canary tag to the PR and triggered deploy: `make deploy-canary SERVICE=cache-service REF=hotfix/evict-check`.

deploy-bot: Deploy started — cache-service@hotfix/evict-check to prod-canary (build #9842).

oncall-bot: Suppressing related alerts for this rollout window. Will auto-resume if error_rate > 1.5% for 2m.

linh: since CI is green and we have an approval, i'm fine with merge once canary is stable for 5m.

alex: merged PR and promoted to prod-canary. initial metrics look good: error_rate down to ~0.2%, p95 latency back to baseline. keeping canary for 10m then promote to prod if steady.

sam: thanks all. will keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
